meaningful base/max rank or explicit non-applicability
crowded moving encounter with another spell and hostile threat
candidate revision and verified viewable artifacts

rows.name: Life Bolt
rows.latest_reviewed_change: dev.31 — source-isolated Life Bolt contact, growing recovery bud and player-directed collection
evidence: Native rank-one and rank-eight full sequences: real projectile damage precedes available planted recovery; a wounded player remains at 30 HP outside pickup range, then walks into seeds and receives the unchanged healing budget.

Rank-eight stationary-target geometry crowd: five seeds at three overlapping locations, readable pale mint buds above enemies and subdued true-radius dotted boundaries. Player moves; enemy AI is disabled. This is not live hostile-combat evidence.

Full-health player approaches without collecting; seeds expire at their actual lifetime. Narrow/reduced rank-eight captures cover overlap and collection. Dedicated lifecycle assertions execute five checks per wounded case and seven for full-health expiry.

Only Life Bolt enemy contact loses the restorative flower bloom. Its original projectile motion and contact punch remain. Collection emits three tiny inward mint motes at the player; existing actual-heal feedback and other seed sources remain unchanged.

Provisional assistant grades: fantasy B-, visuals B-, motion B-, casting/contact C+, sound/camera U, readability B-. Contact remains modest; five observed columns average 2.62, below the 2.7 goal. No new user acceptance or full-roster goal pass.
